grafioschtrader.rest.InstrumentLogoResource
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/instrumentlogo") public class InstrumentLogoResource extends UpdateCreateDeleteAuditResource<InstrumentLogo>
Shared company and issuer SVG logo catalog API. Supports catalog search, backend logo resolution, authenticated delivery of DB-stored SVGs, read-only upload/edit pre-validation for Dialog (D), and standard Grafioschtrader Auditable create/update/delete rights (ROLE_ADMIN / ROLE_ALL_EDIT may edit or delete all entries; ROLE_LIMIT_EDIT only entries they created themselves).

    • updateEntity

      protected org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<InstrumentLogo> updateEntity(InstrumentLogo entity) throws Exception
      Updates an existing catalog logo following standard Grafioschtrader Auditable rights: ROLE_ADMIN and ROLE_ALL_EDIT may update any entry, whereas ROLE_LIMIT_EDIT may only update entries they created themselves. Direct rejection (RIGHTS_SECURITY_BREACH) is used instead of a ProposeChangeEntity because catalog logos have no separate proposal-review screen.
      Overrides:

    • deleteById

      protected Optional<InstrumentLogo> deleteById(Integer id)
      Deletes an unreferenced catalog logo following standard Auditable rights and invalidates the metadata cache. Rejects deletion with a translated violation error when at least one security still references the logo.
